title: Send an invoice
body: Open the draft, check the customer email and press Send. The customer gets a PDF and a payment link. A sent invoice is locked: its lines, currency and due date can no longer be edited.

title: Correct a sent invoice
body: Sent invoices are locked. To fix a wrong amount or currency, issue a credit note for the full invoice, then send a new invoice with the right values. The credit note keeps the original number in your records.

title: Bill in several currencies
body: Each customer has a default currency, set on the customer page. New invoices use it. You can pick another currency on a draft before it is sent. Exchange rates are fixed on the day the invoice is sent.

title: Error INV-409
body: INV-409 means the invoice number is already taken in this workspace. It happens when two people send drafts at the same moment or after an import. Reload the draft; a free number is assigned on the next send.

title: Error INV-412
body: INV-412 means the invoice total does not match the sum of its lines after rounding. It happens with imported invoices that carry their own totals. Recalculate the draft or remove the imported total, then send it again.

title: Charge late fees
body: Turn on late fees in Settings > Payments. Choose a flat fee or a percentage and a grace period in days. The fee is added as a new line when the grace period ends, and the customer gets a reminder email.

title: Automatic payment reminders
body: Reminders go out 3 days before the due date, on the due date and 7 days after it. You can change the schedule or switch reminders off per customer. Paid invoices never get reminders.

title: Refund a payment
body: Open the paid invoice and choose Refund. Card refunds reach the customer in 5 to 10 business days. A partial refund creates a credit note for the refunded amount.

title: Import customers from CSV
body: Upload a CSV with one customer per row. Required columns: name and email. Optional: currency, tax id, address. Rows with an email that already exists update that customer instead of creating a new one.

title: Export to your accounting tool
body: Exports run nightly as CSV files with one row per invoice line. Each row has the invoice number, customer, currency, net amount, tax rate and tax amount. Credit notes appear as negative lines.

title: API tokens
body: Create a token in Settings > Developers. Tokens are shown once; store them in a secret manager. A token can be read-only or read-write, and you can revoke it at any time without affecting other tokens.
